statusReason: The ExLlamaV3 wheel assets are published with upstream SHA-256 digests, but the recommended OpenAI-compatible TabbyAPI backend has no formal release assets and is explicitly a rolling source project. Its startup process installs mutable dependencies, its current dependency profile references a different ExLlama release, and the complete PyTorch, Triton, Flash Linear Attention, TabbyAPI, and transitive dependency set is not yet integrity-pinned by OpenChat. Do not install TabbyAPI from main or treat this catalog entry as ready for user installation.

runtimeRequirements: NVIDIA CUDA 12.8 or newer compatible with the selected PyTorch build
TabbyAPI source must be pinned to an integrity-verified revision before installation
ExLlamaV3 supports EXL3 and FP16/BF16 model formats; selected model files must be downloaded separately
variants.entrypoint: TabbyAPI start.py (requires a pinned source checkout; unavailable in this catalog)
requiredFiles: The TabbyAPI source tree at a pinned commit
PyTorch 2.10.0 CUDA 12.8 and its verified dependencies
triton-windows and flash-linear-attention with verified compatible versions
The selected EXL3, FP16, or BF16 model
